Overview.Name: Anumula Rohink
Overview.Goal: Healthy weight gain, better energy, and overall balance.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (2 eggs) with leafy vegetables (spinach or methi)
Option 2: Boiled eggs (2) + fruit (banana or apple)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice + egg curry + leafy vegetable curry
Option 2: Plain rice + dal + cooked leafy vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Egg curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + leafy vegetables
Option 3: Curd + small portion plain rice + vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Include leafy vegetables daily for micronutrients and digestion.
Eggs and rice together support healthy weight gain.
Do not skip fruits; 1–2 fruits daily is encouraged.
Avoid fried foods even for weight gain.
Eat slowly and finish meals completely.
Consistency with meals matters more than eating large quantities.
